headline: Zoning variances for projects at 200 Allard Drive, 26 Sullivan Street, 1308 Wellington Road, and other addresses, plus two rehearing requests for 102 Talbot Street.
summary: The board will hold public hearings on variance requests for properties across several wards, including new subdivisions, multifamily buildings, setback and parking exceptions, and accessory structures. It will also consider two requests to rehear a previously granted variance for 102 Talbot Street and Crawford Street, approve September 10, 2026 minutes, and discuss other business.
items: ZBA2025-149, 200 Allard Drive: variance for stormwater treatment system, parking setbacks, and fence sign
ZBA2026-078, 26 Sullivan Street: variance for nine-unit multifamily building, height, and retaining wall
ZBA2026-051, 1308 Wellington Road: variance to subdivide into 16 lots near wetland
ZBA2026-085, 1331-1375 Elm Street: variance for two new dwelling units near street façade
ZBA2026-086, 107 Montgomery Street: variance to subdivide lot, setbacks, lot coverage, and transparency
ZBA2026-087, 67 Schiller Street: variance for front yard parking and shed setbacks
ZBA2026-088, 22 Fernand Street: variance for front porch and shed setbacks
ZBA2025-089, 657-659 Montgomery Street: variance to subdivide parcel and side yard setback
ZBA2026-090, 65 Riverdale Avenue: variance for swim spa in street yard
ZBA2026-091, 23 Pond Drive: variance for second-floor addition setback
ZBA2026-092, 124 Vinton Street: variance for two-family dwelling setbacks, impervious surface, garage location, and transparency
ZBA2026-093, 134 Vinton Street: variance for two-family dwelling setbacks, impervious surface, garage location, and transparency
ZBA2026-094, 128 Gantry Street: variance for accessory structures in rear yard
Request for rehearing of ZBA2026-071, 102 Talbot Street and Crawford Street, filed by Michael Durant
Request for rehearing of ZBA2026-071, 102 Talbot Street and Crawford Street, filed by William Reddington, Esq.
